ja.title: PD-L1高発現の肺がんでpembrolizumabに化学療法を足したPFSの差は全生存期間にどこまで残るか。PERSEE試験の公表数値を時点別の生存率で読む
ja.summary: PERSEE試験（pembrolizumab±化学療法、PD-L1 50%以上）の公表数値を時点別の生存率で読み直した。PFSの生存率の差は12〜36か月で約20ポイント、OSの差は確定せず、グレード3以上の治療関連有害事象の割合は34.5ポイント高かった。
ja.seo_description: PERSEE試験（Ann Oncol 2026）のPFS、OS、奏効率、毒性の公表数値を、中央値とハザード比の違い、ランドマークでの絶対差、OSの近似のp値の観点から計算し直した。
ja.seo_title: PERSEE試験の数値をランドマークで読む

en.title: How much of the PFS difference from adding chemotherapy to pembrolizumab in PD-L1-high lung cancer remains in overall survival? Reading the published PERSEE numbers by survival at fixed times
en.summary: The published numbers of PERSEE (pembrolizumab with or without chemotherapy, PD-L1 of 50% or higher) were reread by survival at fixed times. The PFS rate difference is about 20 points at 12 to 36 months, the OS difference is not established, and grade 3 or higher treatment-related AEs are 34.5 points higher.
en.seo_description: The published PFS, OS, response and toxicity numbers of PERSEE (Ann Oncol 2026) were recomputed: medians versus hazard ratio, absolute differences at landmarks and an approximate p value for OS.
